newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Westfield says on track for yr profit rise.
newsitem.headline: Westfield says on track for yr profit rise.

text.p: Shopping centre operator Westfield Holdings Ltd said on Thursday it was on track to record an increase in profits for the year to June 30 which would be in line with the increase in the first half.
"I am pleased to advise that your company is doing well and is looking to the future with optimism," Westfield chairman Frank Lowy told an extraordinary meeting of shareholders.

The meeting was called to vote on the company's plan to expand in the U.S. through its associate, Westfield America Trust, which is due to list on the New York Stock Exchange in May. Westfield said last month it would grant Westfield America Inc options to buy 10 percent of Westfield Holding's existing shares for A$19.6 million.
The meeting later approved three resolutions related to the U.S. expansion plans.
Lowy said there could be some delay to the U.S. float, aimed at raising US$400 million, if there were unsatisfactory market conditions at that time.
Westfield plans to use the proceeds for its US$500 million property acquisition and development plan around the United States.
Wesfield shares were steady at A$21.20 at 10.20 a.m. (0020 GMT) on Thursday.
